metadata.title: Nvidia Stock: The Real Reason the AI Chip Maker Is Buying Hugging Face<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Here’s the Real Reason Nvidia Is Buying Hugging Face
Nvidia’s acquisition of Hugging Face doesn’t make a whole lot of sense on financial grounds. But it’s a lot more logical if you think about it as an insurance policy for the chip maker.
